subject: NULL object reference
notes: cite.py --check 8.4.3.7.3 'NULL is implicitly described as class object and category object reference, and is not a universal object reference' OK 2). As an argument (kb/Work PB1137) NULL crosses BY CONTENT as the formal's null (pb1137_invoke_argument_forms). As INVOKE's identifier-1 (w1112b, kb/Work PB1136) it is an object reference and NOT universal: INVOKE NULL with literal-1 compiles, with BY CONTENT / BY VALUE arguments admitted (14.9.23.3 SR6 is the universal receiver's), and raises EC-OO-NULL (golden pb1136_invoke_null_receiver); identifier-2 through it is refused by SR7 because it is not universal (negative pb1136-invoke-null-identifier-2).
